exposure: cesarean section during labor (as a risk factor for complications)
child's birth weight (as a risk factor for complications)
cohort: 174 pregnant women who delivered between 2021 and 2022 at the Hospital El Idrissi of Kenitra, Morocco.
finding: Maternal obesity was significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery and macrosomia, with macrosomia prevalence being higher in the overweight group compared to the normal weight group.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity was significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Newborn weight, with macrosomia defined as >4000g.
